svg.aria-label: Illustrative. Local apps (Obsidian, a workspace folder, Claude Code, Codex, Apple Notes) appear as closed boxes, then Plexus slices each into capability facets with a verb: obsidian.vault.read (read), workspace.read (read), workspace.write (write), claudecode.run (execute), codex.run (execute), apple-notes.notes.create (write). One self-describing endpoint, GET /.well-known/plexus, on loopback 127.0.0.1:7077. An agent goes DISCOVER, UNDERSTAND, GRANTED, CALL through its launcher plexus-a1: list shows two standing reads and three capabilities that need approval; apple-notes.notes.create is outside its authorized subset. A read flows on its standing grant. A write pends until the owner approves it with a 1h trust window. An execute is approved once, per call. A call outside the subset bounces at the gateway. The owner revokes the workspace.write grant and only that grant goes; the next read still flows. The grants ledger (GET /grants) and the audit log append as each of these happens.
svg.title: Plexus: a local capability gateway for agents
